contracts.title: Open Answer: What will be the (absolute) Electoral College margin in the 2028 US Presidential Election?
contracts.rules:
Electoral College margin = the winning candidate's electoral votes minus the second place's electoral votes.

Answers will be resolved based on the actual Electoral College votes, not electors' pledges. Unfaithful electors may impact the outcome.
